description.en:
Basic Attack - Stringblade

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 1 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4 are in Sheathed Stance.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 are in Drawn Stance.

Heavy Attack - Stringblade

When Qin Heart and Sword Cadence are full, Heavy Attack - Stringblade becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Qin Heart and Sword Cadence and sends Qingxiao into the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mid-air Attack - Stringblade

Press Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
After landing from Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.
While in mid-air, Resonance Skill is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Plunging Attack

While in the Sword Flight state, Jump is replaced by Plunging Attack.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
While out of the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Dodge Counter - Stringblade

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Sword Glide

While in mid-air, Dodge is replaced by Sword Glide.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Stringblade

Tekan berulang kali atau tahan Normal Attack untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 1 dan Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 4 berada dalam Sheathed Stance.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 2 dan Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 3 berada dalam Drawn Stance.

Heavy Attack - Stringblade

Saat Qin Heart dan Sword Cadence penuh, Heavy Attack - Stringblade dapat digunakan.
Tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi STA dan melancarkan skill ini, memberikan Aero DMG.
Melancarkan skill ini mengonsumsi seluruh Qin Heart dan Sword Cadence serta membuat Qingxiao memasuki state Ephemeral Transcendence.

Mid-air Attack - Stringblade

Tekan Normal Attack berturut-turut atau tahan untuk melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG.
Skill ini berada dalam Drawn Stance.
Setelah mendarat dari Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Tahap 3, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 3.
Saat di udara, Resonance Skill diganti dengan Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Tahap 3.

Plunging Attack

Saat dalam state Sword Flight, Jump diganti dengan Plunging Attack.
Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Aero DMG.
Saat tidak dalam state Ephemeral Transcendence, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 3.

Dodge Counter - Stringblade

Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
Skill ini berada dalam Drawn Stance.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 4.

Sword Glide

Saat di udara, Dodge diganti dengan Sword Glide.

description.en:
Severing Note: Judgement

Deal Aero DMG. During this skill, gain 45 points of Qin Heart.
While not in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Severing Note: Ascendant

While casting Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, or Dodge Counter - Stringblade, Resonance Skill is replaced by Severing Note: Ascendant.
Deal Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
description.id:
Severing Note: Judgement

Memberikan Aero DMG. Selama skill ini, mendapat 45 poin Qin Heart.
Saat tidak dalam state Ephemeral Transcendence, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 4.

Severing Note: Ascendant

Saat melancarkan Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 2, Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 3, atau Dodge Counter - Stringblade, Resonance Skill diganti dengan Severing Note: Ascendant.
Memberikan Aero DMG.
Skill ini berada dalam Drawn Stance.

Deal Aero DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
description.id:
Memberikan Aero DMG.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.

skills.name: Sea of Thought, World of Dust

description.en:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 stacks of Gathered Mind.

After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the Mindlock effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the Gathered Mind effect, gain Gathered Mind with stacks equal to the target's Mindlock stacks.
If Qingxiao already has Gathered Mind and the target's Mindlock stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks, Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks will be matched to the target's Mindlock stacks.

Gathered Mind

After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict Mindlock equal to Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast Tune Break, if the target has Tune Strain - Shifting, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain Gathered Mind, and any existing Gathered Mind effect becomes inactive.
Gathered Mind stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.
description.id:
Saat memasuki pertempuran, mendapat 1 stack Gathered Mind.

Setelah damage langsung dari Resonator dalam tim mengalahkan target yang terkena efek Mindlock:
Jika Qingxiao tidak memiliki efek Gathered Mind, mendapat Gathered Mind dengan stack sebanyak stack Mindlock target.
Jika Qingxiao sudah memiliki Gathered Mind dan stack Mindlock target tidak kurang dari stack Gathered Mind Qingxiao, stack Gathered Mind Qingxiao disamakan dengan stack Mindlock target.

Gathered Mind

Setelah Resonator dalam tim memberikan damage kepada target, memberikan Mindlock sebanyak stack Gathered Mind Qingxiao. Efek ini hanya dapat dipicu 1 kali pada target yang sama.
Saat Resonator dalam tim melancarkan Tune Break, jika target memiliki Tune Strain - Shifting, juga memberikan 1 stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target. Efek ini hanya dapat dipicu 1 kali pada target yang sama.
Saat Qingxiao tumbang, ia tidak dapat lagi mendapat Gathered Mind, dan efek Gathered Mind yang ada menjadi tidak aktif.
Gathered Mind bertumpuk hingga 15 kali dan berlangsung selama 30 dtk.

description.en:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of Mindlock on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.
description.id:
Skill Qingxiao berikut memberikan 2% DMG lebih banyak per stack Mindlock pada target, dengan tambahan 5% per stack untuk 7 stack pertama.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Setiap kali Resonator dalam tim memberikan Tune Strain - Interfered pada target Overlord Class atau Calamity Class, juga memberikan 1 stack Mindlock pada target.

description.en:
Deal Aero DMG. Casting the skill restores 30 points of Sword Cadence and grants Resonant Chime.

Resonant Chime

Casting Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement grants 30 points of Qin Heart and removes Resonant Chime.
description.id:
Memberikan Aero DMG. Melancarkan skill ini memulihkan 30 poin Sword Cadence dan memberikan Resonant Chime.

Resonant Chime

Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement memberikan 30 poin Qin Heart dan menghapus Resonant Chime.

description.en:
Ephemeral Transcendence

While Qingxiao is in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence and Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence become available.

Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence

Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence

When Heart Sword Intent is full, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available. Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Heart Sword Intent and ends the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mindlock

Mindlock stacks up to 15 times.
Each time a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on a target, inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.
For each stack of Mindlock on the target, DMG taken from Qingxiao's following skills is Amplified by 2%, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Heaven's Clarity

Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation Billows Beneath Heaven, gain Heaven's Clarity.
When Sheathed Stance/Drawn Stance skills deal damage, the rates at which Qin Heart/Sword Cadence are obtained increase by 100%.
When casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade, inflict 3 stacks of Mindlock on nearby targets, and enhance the next Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence: its DMG Multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target. Switching to another Resonator ends the Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence enhancement.
Casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence removes Heaven's Clarity.

Swordlight Ward

Casting Intro Skill - Tonality Shift or Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants 1 stacks of Swordlight Ward.
Swordlight Ward stacks up to 1 times. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, 1 stack of Swordlight Ward can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Sword Flight

While in the Sword Flight state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.
Moving in Sword Flight continuously consumes Flight Qi.
- Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the Sword Flight state:
Sword Glide, Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Severing Note: Ascendant, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, and Intro Skill - Tonality Shift.
- Exit the Sword Flight state by:
1. Casting Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 or Plunging Attack.
2. Triggering certain environmental interactions or Utilities.
3. Returning to the ground.
4. Switching to another Resonator.
5. Depleting all Flight Qi.

Sword Step

While in the Sword Flight state, hold Jump to leap up and dash forward a short distance.
Sword Step can only be cast once during Sword Flight.

Qin Heart

Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Sheathed Stance skills grants Qin Heart.
Qin Heart cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Sword Cadence

Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Drawn Stance skills grants Sword Cadence.
Sword Cadence cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Heart Sword Intent

Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence or Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence grants Heart Sword Intent.
description.id:
Ephemeral Transcendence

Saat Qingxiao dalam state Ephemeral Transcendence, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence dan Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence dapat digunakan.

Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence

Tekan berulang kali atau tahan Normal Attack untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG.
Sebelum Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence dapat digunakan, pengali DMG skill ini meningkat sebesar 100%.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence

Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
Sebelum Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence dapat digunakan, pengali DMG skill ini meningkat sebesar 100%.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence

Saat Heart Sword Intent penuh, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence dapat digunakan. Tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan skill, memberikan Aero DMG.
Melancarkan skill ini mengonsumsi seluruh Heart Sword Intent dan mengakhiri state Ephemeral Transcendence.

Mindlock

Mindlock bertumpuk hingga 15 kali.
Setiap kali Resonator dalam tim memberikan Tune Strain - Interfered pada target, memberikan 1 stack Mindlock pada target.
Untuk setiap stack Mindlock pada target, DMG yang diterima dari skill Qingxiao berikut di-Amplify sebesar 2%, dengan tambahan 5% per stack untuk 7 stack pertama.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Heaven's Clarity

Saat memasuki pertempuran atau melancarkan Resonance Liberation Billows Beneath Heaven, mendapat Heaven's Clarity.
Saat skill Sheathed Stance/Drawn Stance memberikan damage, laju perolehan Qin Heart/Sword Cadence meningkat sebesar 100%.
Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Stringblade, memberikan 3 stack Mindlock pada target di sekitar, dan meningkatkan Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence berikutnya: pengali DMG-nya meningkat sebesar 100% dan menambah Off-Tune Level pada target. Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri peningkatan Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence.
Melancarkan Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence menghapus Heaven's Clarity.

Swordlight Ward

Melancarkan Intro Skill - Tonality Shift atau Heavy Attack - Stringblade memberikan 1 stack Swordlight Ward.
Swordlight Ward bertumpuk hingga 1 kali. Saat menerima DMG dari serangan musuh, 1 stack Swordlight Ward dapat dikonsumsi untuk memberikan kekebalan terhadap interupsi dan mengurangi DMG yang diterima sebesar 60% selama 1 dtk. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali per detik.

Sword Flight

Saat dalam state Sword Flight, Qingxiao bergerak dengan animasi khusus.
Bergerak dalam Sword Flight terus mengonsumsi Flight Qi.
- Melancarkan skill berikut membuat Qingxiao memasuki state Sword Flight:
Sword Glide, Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Tahap 1, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Tahap 2, Severing Note: Ascendant, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, dan Intro Skill - Tonality Shift.
- Keluar dari state Sword Flight dengan:
1. Melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Tahap 3 atau Plunging Attack.
2. Memicu interaksi lingkungan atau Utilities tertentu.
3. Kembali ke tanah.
4. Berganti ke Resonator lain.
5. Menghabiskan seluruh Flight Qi.

Sword Step

Saat dalam state Sword Flight, tahan Jump untuk melompat dan melesat ke depan sejauh jarak pendek.
Sword Step hanya dapat dilancarkan sekali selama Sword Flight.

Qin Heart

Dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin.
Memberikan damage dengan skill Sheathed Stance memberikan Qin Heart.
Qin Heart tidak dapat diperoleh saat dalam state Ephemeral Transcendence.

Sword Cadence

Dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin.
Memberikan damage dengan skill Drawn Stance memberikan Sword Cadence.
Sword Cadence tidak dapat diperoleh saat dalam state Ephemeral Transcendence.

Heart Sword Intent

Dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin.
Memberikan damage dengan Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence atau Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence memberikan Heart Sword Intent.

description.en:
Qingxiao inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target after dealing damage with skills. Each skill can only trigger this once for the same target.
Qingxiao can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.
Responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, every point of Qingxiao's Tune Break Boost increases the total DMG Qingxiao deals to that target by 0.12%. While Qingxiao is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.
Additionally, when the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Qingxiao can cast Tune Break on it. While on the ground and not in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Tune Break to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.
description.id:
Qingxiao memberikan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target setelah memberikan damage dengan skill. Setiap skill hanya dapat memicu ini sekali untuk target yang sama.
Qingxiao dapat merespons Tune Strain - Interfered.
Merespons Tune Strain - Interfered: Untuk setiap stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target, setiap poin Tune Break Boost Qingxiao meningkatkan total DMG yang diberikan Qingxiao kepada target tersebut sebesar 0,12%. Selama Qingxiao berada dalam tim, batas stack maksimum Tune Strain - Interfered pada target meningkat sebanyak 1.
Selain itu, saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Qingxiao dapat melancarkan Tune Break padanya. Saat di darat dan tidak dalam state Ephemeral Transcendence, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan Tune Break untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Stringblade Tahap 3.

sequences.name: Like Clouds That Meet and Drift Apart

description.en:
Crit. Rate is increased by 16%.

The max stack limit of Swordlight Ward is increased to 2. Casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade additionally grants 1 stacks of Swordlight Ward.

Upon entering combat, gain 25 stack of Exorcising Seal.
After Basic Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade, or Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence deals damage, if Qingxiao has Exorcising Seal, remove all Exorcising Seal stacks and trigger Juque Perdition, dealing Aero DMG equal to 400% of Qingxiao's ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once per second. For each stack of Exorcising Seal removed, the target takes 4% more DMG from Juque Perdition for 2s.
Exorcising Seal stacks up to 25 times.
description.id:
Crit. Rate meningkat sebesar 16%.

Batas stack maksimum Swordlight Ward meningkat menjadi 2. Melancarkan Heavy Attack - Stringblade juga memberikan 1 stack Swordlight Ward.

Saat memasuki pertempuran, mendapat 25 stack Exorcising Seal.
Setelah Basic Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade, atau Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence memberikan damage, jika Qingxiao memiliki Exorcising Seal, hapus seluruh stack Exorcising Seal dan picu Juque Perdition, memberikan Aero DMG sebesar 400% ATK Qingxiao, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Efek ini dapat dipicu hingga sekali per detik. Untuk setiap stack Exorcising Seal yang dihapus, target menerima 4% DMG lebih banyak dari Juque Perdition selama 2 dtk.
Exorcising Seal bertumpuk hingga 25 kali.

sequences.name: Like Petals That Fall Without a Sound

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack - Stringblade is increased by 40%.

After entering combat, the max stack limit of Mindlock on nearby enemies is increased to 25.
The max stack limit of Gathered Mind from Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust is increased to 25.

Heaven's Clarity is enhanced:
Casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade now inflicts 6 stack of Mindlock on nearby targets.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Heavy Attack - Stringblade meningkat sebesar 40%.

Setelah memasuki pertempuran, batas stack maksimum Mindlock pada musuh di sekitar meningkat menjadi 25.
Batas stack maksimum Gathered Mind dari Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust meningkat menjadi 25.

Heaven's Clarity ditingkatkan:
Melancarkan Heavy Attack - Stringblade kini memberikan 6 stack Mindlock pada target di sekitar.

description.en:
The Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven is increased by 100%.

During Heavy Attack - Stringblade, gain World in Chorus stacks equal to the highest Mindlock stack count present among nearby enemies.
World in Chorus: Each stack increases the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence by 3%. World in Chorus is removed after casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence.

The Gathered Mind effect of Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust now inflicts 2 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered.
description.id:
Crit. DMG Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven meningkat sebesar 100%.

Selama Heavy Attack - Stringblade, mendapat stack World in Chorus sebanyak jumlah stack Mindlock tertinggi di antara musuh di sekitar.
World in Chorus: Setiap stack meningkatkan pengali DMG Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence sebesar 3%. World in Chorus dihapus setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence.

Efek Gathered Mind dari Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust kini memberikan 2 stack Tune Strain - Interfered.

description.en: After a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting, their ATK is increased by 20% for 8s.
description.id: Setelah Resonator dalam tim memberikan Tune Strain - Shifting, ATK mereka meningkat sebesar 20% selama 8 dtk.

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement is increased by 100%.

While moving in Sword Flight, Flight Qi cost is reduced by 30%.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement meningkat sebesar 100%.

Saat bergerak dalam Sword Flight, biaya Flight Qi berkurang 30%.

sequences.name: Cleanse This Tarnished Age, Till All Runs Clear

description.en:
Targets take 40% more DMG from Qingxiao's Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven, and Juque Perdition.

During Heavy Attack - Stringblade, gain Exorcising Seal stacks equal to the highest Mindlock stack count present among nearby enemies.

For each stack of Mindlock on the target, the DMG of Juque Perdition taken by the target is Amplified by 2%. The first 7 stack additionally grant 5% DMG Amplification.

When Inherent Skill - To Know, To Banish is unlocked, the DMG of Juque Perdition on targets with Mindlock is increased by 2% for each stack of Mindlock. The first 7 stacks additionally grant 5% DMG increase.

The effect of Qingxiao's response to Tune Strain - Interfered is increased by 20%.
description.id:
Target menerima 40% DMG lebih banyak dari Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven, dan Juque Perdition Qingxiao.

Selama Heavy Attack - Stringblade, mendapat stack Exorcising Seal sebanyak jumlah stack Mindlock tertinggi di antara musuh di sekitar.

Untuk setiap stack Mindlock pada target, DMG Juque Perdition yang diterima target di-Amplify sebesar 2%. 7 stack pertama memberikan tambahan 5% DMG Amplification.

Saat Inherent Skill - To Know, To Banish terbuka, DMG Juque Perdition pada target dengan Mindlock meningkat sebesar 2% untuk setiap stack Mindlock. 7 stack pertama memberikan tambahan peningkatan DMG sebesar 5%.

Efek respons Qingxiao terhadap Tune Strain - Interfered meningkat sebesar 20%.
